more_info.overview: Magnesium salts of fatty acids is used as an anti-caking agent in food. Its technological role is to help powders stay free-flowing.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include table-top sweeteners in tablets. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Magnesium salts are prepared from fatty acids obtained from edible fats or oils. The specification does not identify a single biological source for those fats.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for assessed food uses.
The reviewed evidence did not indicate mutagenic or cancer effects.
